description: A four-line feedback delay network reverb after the Erbe-Verb: a space whose size runs continuously from a coffin to the heavens without changing algorithm, and every control takes voltage

params.text: Sets the network's delay, 1ms to 500ms, running from a coffin fully anticlockwise through a room at noon, a plate, a hall and the heavens fully clockwise; it also scales the early reflections
Sets the delay before the first reflections, 7ms to 500ms, independently of the size; with a clock patched it becomes a ratio of that clock instead
Sets the gain of the feedback loop alone, 0% to 120%, which is how long the tail runs rather than how much reverb there is; past about 100% the tail stops decaying and feeds on itself
Sets diffusion and damping in one turn: no diffusion and no damping fully anticlockwise, full diffusion and no damping about a fifth of the way up, and full diffusion and full damping fully clockwise
Sets both how deep the modulation goes and what it does: nothing at noon, a multiphase sine vibrato in the four delay lines anticlockwise, and grains scattering the room dimensions clockwise
Sets the rate of whichever modulation depth has chosen, 0.5Hz to 256Hz; with a clock patched it becomes a ratio of that clock, and with depth at noon it does nothing
Tilts the tone of the output, cutting highs and lifting lows anticlockwise and the reverse clockwise, flat at noon; it comes after the network so it never touches the feedback
Crossfades the dry and reverberated signals at equal power
Attenuates and inverts the voltage at the jack beside it before it is added to the knob above, -100% to +100%
Reverses the pre-delay buffer while it is latched on, with a short crossfade so it does not click; the pre-delay knob sets the length of the reversed buffer

inputs.text: The left side of the signal to reverberate
The right side of the signal to reverberate; with nothing patched here the left jack feeds both sides
While a clock is patched here, the pre-delay and speed knobs snap to ratios of it, from a twelfth up to twelve times, with 1 to 1 at noon
Above its threshold the pre-delay buffer plays backwards, and releasing it returns to forwards
Added to the size knob through the attenuverter beside it, ±5V for the knob's whole range
Added to the pre-delay knob through the attenuverter beside it, ±5V for the knob's whole range
Added to the decay knob through the attenuverter beside it, ±5V for the knob's whole range
Added to the absorb knob through the attenuverter beside it, ±5V for the knob's whole range
Added to the depth knob through the attenuverter beside it, ±5V for the knob's whole range
Added to the speed knob through the attenuverter beside it, ±5V for the knob's whole range
Added to the tilt knob through the attenuverter beside it, ±5V for the knob's whole range
Added to the mix knob through the attenuverter beside it, ±5V for the knob's whole range

outputs.text: The left side of the reverb crossfaded with the dry signal
The right side of the reverb crossfaded with the dry signal
The energy in the network as 0V to 10V, from an envelope follower on the reverb itself: patch it into decay through an inverting attenuverter and the reverb reins itself in

notes: the four delay times are kept mutually prime and all scale together from the size control, so sweeping size is a mass of coordinated pitch shifts rather than a jump between presets.
with decay at the bottom the network passes one diffused pass plus the early reflections, which is the gated end of that knob rather than silence.
at full shimmer the octave-up voice replaces the direct injection into the network, and because the shimmer line is fed the network output too the octaves stack as the tail develops.
menu: Shimmer: Folded into depth, Off, 25%, 50%, 100% — where the octave-up voice comes from; folded in, it rides the top fifth of the depth knob, and the rest unlink it
